episodes.title: Because I Always Look at You.
episodes.summary: Kang-hee, the daughter of a motel owner, leaves the boring countryside after spending a night with her first love Yeon-soo. She meets Yeon-soo again after 10 years...

episodes.title: I Want to Get Away From That Man Now.
episodes.summary: Kang-hee and Yeon-soo break up without being able to convey their true feelings to each other. As both of them feel regret, Kang-hee's birthday, which also falls on Christmas, is approaching.

episodes.title: Who Told You to Show Up Unexpectedly?
episodes.summary: Yeon-soo prepares for a perfect reunion with Kang-hee but Kang-hee wants to part ways from him. Then Kang-hee, who is only focused on work, suddenly gets an unexpected task.

episodes.title: You Didn't Keep a Single Promise You Made to Me!
episodes.summary: Kang-hee confirms the woman who will marry Yeon-soo. She gets angry and drinks alone until she passes out. Then someone picks Kang-hee up and takes her to Motel California.

episodes.title: Cheon Yeon-soo, Do You Like Me?
episodes.summary: Kang-hee explodes with resentment towards Yeon-soo. Yeon-soo does his best to help Kang-hee, but their true feelings are increasingly diverging.

episodes.title: I'm Sorry, I Didn't Know.
episodes.summary: Kang-hee acknowledges the relationship between Yeon-soo and Nan-woo. She congratulates them by giving them her grandfather's ring, but then she hears an unexpected truth from Yeon-soo.

episodes.title: Can We Be Friends?
episodes.summary: Yeon-soo started to counterattack after Kang-hee said that they should remain friends even after the kiss. Kang-hee is flustered by Yeon-soo's unfamiliar appearance that she saw for the first time.

episodes.title: I Won't Be Friends with Kang-hee Anymore.
episodes.summary: The two friends spend a night at Kang-hee's house. Who will cross the line first in this tightrope walk?

episodes.title: It's the First Day from Today.
episodes.summary: Kang-hee and Yeon-soo finally confirm their feelings for each other. But as things get more complicated, the two end up running away to Seoul...

episodes.title: Whenever You're Cold and Tired, Come to Me.
episodes.summary: Kang-hee and Yeon-soo get into a car accident while on their way to Seoul together. Kang-hee, who regains his lost memories, is caught up in great confusion and shock.

episodes.title: Now, Are You Okay?
episodes.summary: Kang-hee is overcome with guilt. Yeon-soo knows another secret and avoids Kang-hee. In the end, Yeon-soo comes to Kang-hee who is about to leave...

episodes.title: Motel California is Leaving Us.
episodes.summary: Yeon-soo comforts Kang-hee who is shocked to learn of Chun-pil's illness. Meanwhile, Motel California falls into crisis due to Chun-pil's unexpected decision.
